deviations.what: R6 was converted from its "feature"-style bullet lists (Deliverables/Out of scope) to descriptive prose on marking it delivered, rather than only swapping its status tag from *feature* to *Delivered*.
deviations.why: R1, R2 and R4 — the roadmap's other already-delivered items — are all written as prose with no Deliverables/Out-of-scope bullets; those bullets are how still-open items are written. Keeping R6's bullets with only the tag changed would read as future-tense work against a status claiming it is done.

deviations.what: R7's deliverables list was trimmed from six items to two, rather than only striking the one superseded item T039 named.
deviations.why: D1 records that this feature already built three of R7's six original deliverables (the role, the private-until-approved rule, the decision queue) as part of delivering R6. Leaving them listed as still-to-build would contradict what was built, which the task's own acceptance criterion forbids. Only the outside-contributor entry point, and test coverage for it, remain open.

deviations.what: Added a short paragraph to CONTEXT.md's new Data Assessor entry noting that the Review model's `reviewers` field and `heat_flow_reviews` related name keep their pre-rename spelling.
deviations.why: D3 (pre-existing, from the plan) already recorded this as a deliberate choice — the code-level names are not renamed even though the glossary terms are.
